comment: Fixed prompts for B2's quality check (scripts/quantize/quality.py). 'exact' items have one checkable answer, scored by whether the reply contains it (case-insensitive). 'open' items have none, and are compared across models only for divergence. Written for this repo; no external dataset.

exact.q: What is 17 multiplied by 23? Reply with only the number.
What is 144 divided by 12? Reply with only the number.
What is 2 to the power of 10? Reply with only the number.
What is 1000 minus 387? Reply with only the number.
What is the square root of 169? Reply with only the number.
How many minutes are in 3.5 hours? Reply with only the number.
What is 15% of 240? Reply with only the number.
A train travels 180 km in 2 hours. What is its average speed in km/h? Reply with only the number.
What is the capital of Australia? Reply with one word.
What is the capital of Canada? Reply with one word.
What is the capital of Japan? Reply with one word.
What is the capital of Kenya? Reply with one word.
What is the chemical symbol for gold? Reply with only the symbol.
What is the chemical symbol for sodium? Reply with only the symbol.
How many sides does a hexagon have? Reply with only the number.
How many bits are in a byte? Reply with only the number.
Which planet is closest to the Sun? Reply with one word.
Which planet is known as the Red Planet? Reply with one word.
What is the largest ocean on Earth? Reply with one word.
What gas do plants absorb from the air for photosynthesis? Reply with its chemical formula only.
What is the boiling point of water at sea level in degrees Celsius? Reply with only the number.
Who wrote the play Romeo and Juliet? Reply with the surname only.
In what year did the first crewed Moon landing take place? Reply with only the year.
What is the next number in the sequence 2, 4, 8, 16? Reply with only the number.
Reverse the word 'stressed'. Reply with only the reversed word.
What is the plural of 'mouse' when it refers to the animal? Reply with one word.
In Python, what does len([3, 1, 4, 1, 5]) return? Reply with only the number.
In Python, what is 7 // 2? Reply with only the number.
What HTTP status code means 'Not Found'? Reply with only the number.
If today is Monday, what day is it in 10 days? Reply with one word.
